title: Computed-Tomography-Based Radiomics Model for Predicting the Malignant Potential of Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumors Preoperatively: A Multi-Classifier and Multicenter Study.
summary: Random forest was the strongest model in the 180-patient training center and 144-patient external-center cohort. External replication and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
ai_technology: CT radiomic features fed logistic regression, SVM and random-forest models for preoperative GIST risk grading.
